title: Ancestry search places Sherman in Omaha near Offutt AFB
place_text: Omaha, Nebraska / Offutt Air Force Base

tellings.quote: The results showed that Sherman likely in fact lived in Omaha, Nebraska between 1993 and 1994

plain: A genealogy records search is said to show that Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, lived in Omaha, Nebraska, near Offutt Air Force Base, in 1993 and 1994. Michels reports this himself, citing a man named Richard Geldreich and an ancestry.com search whose results showed Sherman "likely in fact lived in Omaha." It is offered as backing for Sherman's account of where he served.
